self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Interlude: +480 Elemental Mastery for 10s on switch-in. The stat key was "em", which no part of the evaluator reads, so this buff did nothing at all until 2026-08-23; it is "eleMas". One of three themes, chosen at random and mutually exclusive - set an uptime rather than enabling several.
Recitative: +120% ATK for 10s on switch-in. One of three themes, chosen at random and mutually exclusive - set an uptime rather than enabling several.
Aria: +96% Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s on switch-in. One of three themes, chosen at random and mutually exclusive - set an uptime rather than enabling several.

DEPRECATED - do not use on new leaderboards. averaged each buff with every 2nd rot, 1/3 chance The Widsith grants exactly ONE of its three themes at a time, so blending a fraction of each into one stat line is not the average of the damage: E[dmg(buff)] != dmg(E[buff]), and you end up with EM and ATK the weapon can never grant together. Pick the theme the rotation actually plays around and give that condition an uptime instead.

DEPRECATED - do not use on new leaderboards. averaged each buff with 10/30s, 1/3 chance The Widsith grants exactly ONE of its three themes at a time, so blending a fraction of each into one stat line is not the average of the damage: E[dmg(buff)] != dmg(E[buff]), and you end up with EM and ATK the weapon can never grant together. Pick the theme the rotation actually plays around and give that condition an uptime instead.

en.flavor: A heavy notebook filled with musical scores. Though suffering from moth damage and heavy wear-and-tear, there is still much power to be found among the hand-written words within.
